sourceDefinitions.name: FastNear public mainnet RPC (free tier) — finalized block

sourceDefinitions.name: FastNear public mainnet RPC (free tier) — sampled block transactions
sourceDefinitions.fields: transaction-array lengths for every shard chunk referenced by one finalized block; matched chunk hashes and per-shard counts
sourceDefinitions.cadence: Sampled on initial load and no more than once every five minutes; one chunk read per shard in that block.
sourceDefinitions.caveat: A count for one finalized block is not a daily series, unique-user count or adoption trend. The finalized block and minimal chunk verification fields plus transaction hashes are retained locally for replay; full transaction bodies and receipt payloads are discarded. FastNear’s free-tier request limit is not published; the app samples conservatively.

sourceDefinitions.cadence: Fetched on load and then every five minutes.

overviewChart.title: Daily market and liquidity context
overviewChart.plainLanguage: Each point uses a complete UTC date shared by the market and TVL sources; missing dates and the current partial day are excluded.
overviewChart.source: CoinGecko daily market history and DefiLlama historical NEAR TVL
overviewChart.query:
GET https://api.coingecko.com/api/v3/coins/near/market_chart?vs_currency=usd&days=32&interval=daily
GET https://api.llama.fi/v2/historicalChainTvl/near

Join on the exact UTC calendar date. Select priceUsd, tvlUsd, or grossVolumeUsd from the matched rows. No date interpolation is applied.

gasChart.title: Gas used per sampled finalized block
gasChart.plainLanguage: This chart records real finalized-block gas observations collected in this browser; it is not a historical chain archive or a fee-revenue series.
gasChart.query:
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":"near-signal-block","method":"block","params":{"finality":"final"}}

For each returned block, sum chunks[].gas_used, then divide by 10^12 to display Tgas. Retain the raw block and observation timestamp in browser-local evidence history. Export evidence, then run npm run replay -- path/to/evidence.json to reconstruct each point offline.

blockTxChart.title: Transactions per sampled finalized block
blockTxChart.plainLanguage: The total is shown only after every shard chunk for a finalized block matches its referenced shard, chunk hash, and inclusion height.
blockTxChart.query:
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":"near-signal-block","method":"block","params":{"finality":"final"}}

For every returned block.chunks[] entry, call chunk with {"block_id": block.header.height, "shard_id": chunk.shard_id}. Verify chunk_hash, shard_id, and height_included; sum the length of each chunk.transactions array. A missing or mismatched chunk withholds the total. Retain the raw block plus each matched chunk’s shard/hash/inclusion fields and transaction hashes in the evidence export; full transaction bodies and receipt payloads are discarded; npm run replay -- path/to/evidence.json repeats validation offline.

unexecutedBigQuery.sql:
-- On-chain account/activity proxies, not verified people or organic adoption.
-- Parameters: @start_date DATE inclusive; @end_date DATE exclusive;
-- @contract_account_id STRING, the exact receiver contract account.
WITH daily_activity AS (
  SELECT
    block_date,
    COUNT(DISTINCT transaction_hash) AS transaction_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT signer_account_id) AS active_signer_accounts
  FROM \`bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us.transactions\`
  WHERE block_date >= @start_date AND block_date < @end_date
  GROUP BY block_date
),
receipt_origins AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, originated_from_transaction_hash
  FROM \`bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us.receipt_origin_transaction\`
  WHERE block_date >= @start_date AND block_date < @end_date
),
contract_usage AS (
  SELECT
    ra.block_date,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ro.originated_from_transaction_hash) AS contract_transactions,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ra.signer_account_id) AS contract_signer_accounts,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ra.receipt_id) AS function_call_receipts,
    COUNT(DISTINCT IF(ro.originated_from_transaction_hash IS NULL, ra.receipt_id, NULL))
      AS receipts_without_in_window_origin
  FROM \`bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us.receipt_actions\` AS ra
  LEFT JOIN receipt_origins AS ro ON ro.receipt_id = ra.receipt_id
  WHERE ra.block_date >= @start_date AND ra.block_date < @end_date
    AND ra.action_kind = 'FUNCTION_CALL'
    AND ra.receipt_receiver_account_id = @contract_account_id
  GROUP BY ra.block_date
)
SELECT
  activity.block_date,
  activity.transaction_count,
  activity.active_signer_accounts,
  COALESCE(usage.contract_transactions, 0) AS contract_transactions,
  COALESCE(usage.contract_signer_accounts, 0) AS contract_signer_accounts,
  COALESCE(usage.function_call_receipts, 0) AS function_call_receipts,
  COALESCE(usage.receipts_without_in_window_origin, 0) AS receipts_without_in_window_origin
FROM daily_activity AS activity
LEFT JOIN contract_usage AS usage USING (block_date)
ORDER BY activity.block_date;

selectedDescriptiveTest.claimLabel: NEAR price and TVL daily changes move in the same direction

calculation.summary: Pearson r=0.98 across 14 matched daily changes (2026-10-31 to 2026-11-13). The declared rule treats |r| ≥ 0.30 in the expected direction as support. This is descriptive co-movement, not causation or a significance test.

selectedDescriptiveTest.rule: Pearson r threshold ±0.30; requires the full selected consecutive sample; no p-value or causal interpretation

riskStates.title: Validator stake concentration
riskStates.trend: One current-epoch validator set; prior epochs are not yet collected.
riskStates.confidence: High for RPC-reported active-set stakes; does not represent all stakers or ecosystem apps
riskStates.evidence: 345 current validators; top 10 hold 35.9% of stake in the reported set (HHI 217).
riskStates.impact: Validator stake concentration is a governance and production-dependency indicator, not proof of collusion or a security failure.
riskStates.next: Compare multiple epochs and add independently sourced application/contract concentration before broadening this risk.

riskStates.title: Network activity / adoption quality
riskStates.severity: Unrated — one finalized-block count cannot establish user adoption
riskStates.trend: One finalized block sample: 4 transactions across 10 shard chunks; no daily or unique-user trend.
riskStates.confidence: High for the returned transaction arrays in this block; insufficient for adoption, retention or a trend
riskStates.evidence: 4 transactions across 10 shard chunks in finalized block 224,491,125 (2026-11-14T08:51:22.426Z). Transaction identities are not retained.
riskStates.impact: A block-local transaction count indicates activity in one sample; it does not identify users, returning behaviour, application diversity or adoption quality.
riskStates.next: Collect a permitted consecutive block series, then add independently authorized account cohorts, retention and application-diversity evidence.

riskStates.title: Liquidity stock (TVL)
riskStates.trend: DefiLlama-reported NEAR DeFi TVL changed -34.5% over 30 days.
riskStates.confidence: Moderate for provider-reported USD TVL; low for net flows or capital retention
riskStates.evidence: TVL is an indexed asset stock and is affected by token prices. It is not a bridge flow, net inflow or retained investment.
riskStates.impact: A sustained fall in TVL can indicate lower reported DeFi balances, but price changes and coverage changes may explain part of it.
riskStates.next: Check underlying assets, protocol coverage and price-adjusted changes before calling a TVL move an ecosystem capital flow.

riskStates.title: Infrastructure freshness
riskStates.trend: A live point-in-time RPC view; local history only accumulates while this browser remains open.
riskStates.confidence: High for the returned block/status; low for global network health or uptime
riskStates.evidence: Finalized block 224,491,125 is 8.5 seconds old; queried node syncing=false.
riskStates.impact: This can reveal an old block or syncing node view, but one provider cannot establish a network-wide outage or consensus fault.
riskStates.next: Compare multiple independent RPC providers and keep a persistent observation history before making availability claims.

riskStates.title: Economic signal
riskStates.severity: No configured 24-hour market decline threshold crossed
riskStates.trend: CoinGecko aggregated NEAR price changed -6.18% over 24 hours.
riskStates.confidence: Moderate for aggregated market data; not protocol value capture
riskStates.evidence: Latest finalized block used 53.22 Tgas; estimated gas cost 0.005322 Ⓝ. This is not protocol revenue.
riskStates.impact: Market repricing and per-block execution cost are separate observations; neither establishes sustainable token value capture.
riskStates.next: Add a permitted historical fee series and protocol-level token-economic context before assessing long-run value capture.

riskStates.title: Ecosystem dependencies
riskStates.trend: Not available — no verified protocol, bridge or critical-service dependency history is connected.
riskStates.evidence: No sourced inventory of major applications, liquidity providers, bridges or infrastructure operators is integrated.
riskStates.impact: Critical external-service or protocol concentration could create risk that this live-feed MVP does not map.
riskStates.next: Build a cited dependency register and connect it to an authorized incident and liquidity dataset.

limitations: The transaction count covers one finalized block sample. It is not a daily series, unique-user count, retention measure or adoption trend.
Daily account cohorts, verified people and returning-user retention remain unavailable because no permitted account-history source is connected.
No canonical, deduplicated bridge or NEAR Intents net-flow history is connected.
The validator summary covers the RPC-reported current active set, not all stakers or historical validator performance.
One public RPC node status and browser-local observations do not establish network-wide uptime or security.
Market capitalization and volume are aggregated exchange-market measures. TVL is a daily USD asset stock. Neither is net investment or protocol revenue.
The NEAR Ecosystem Health Score is withheld because important evidence dimensions are unavailable.
The selected correlation is descriptive only. It does not establish causation, statistical significance, independence or a forecast.
Provider access, freshness, shared limits and endpoint availability can change. Successful access does not establish public/commercial permission or an SLA.
